body.x: FLIR Systems(www.flir.com) unveiled the first personal thermal imaging device, FLIR ONE for iPhone5 at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th..
FLIR ONE is compatible with the iPhone5 and 5s and fits on the phone like a protective case. The device features image capturing, so users can share the images by sending to SNS or email.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
